# account-creation-ui-mockup.png

**Type:** UI wireframe/mockup (not a UML diagram).
**Source context:** `# Description` section, illustrating the 5 steps
narrated in the surrounding text.

A 5-panel wireframe of a fictional "Lambda Welcome" portal, showing the
account-creation flow from the end user's perspective, in sequence:

1. **Step 1** — "Lambda Welcome" landing screen with a menu (Identify
   Yourself, **Create your Account**, Our B2C Catalogue, News); the user
   selects "Create your Account."
2. **Step 2** — "Create your Account" form: title (Mr/Ms), Firstname
   (`John`), Lastname (`Smith`), phone number or email address
   (`john.smith@emailprovider.com`, marked as one contact method
   mandatory), Cancel/Validate buttons.
3. **Step 3** — Same form extended with credential fields: login
   (`login123`) and password (masked), plus a note that password
   criteria apply; Back/Cancel/Validate buttons.
4. **Step 4** — "Receive Our Emails" consent screen: confirms the email
   address, offers an opt-in checkbox for marketing updates, and a
   mandatory checkbox for terms of use/privacy policy/cookies/personal
   data transfer acceptance.
5. **Step 5** — Returns to "Lambda Welcome," now showing the
   authenticated user (initials "JS"), an updated menu (Our B2C
   Catalogue, New Order, News), and the confirmation message "Your
   account has been successfully created!"

Red arrows connect the panels in order, matching the "Step 1" through
"Step 5" narrative in the `# Description` section's body text.
